text:
alex: FYI — small but nasty: customer using our python quickstart hit duplicate onboarding profiles after a 429 + token refresh. they reported double billing. attaching redacted logs. @priya can you triage?
priya: can you paste the short log snippet + sdk version?
alex: python quickstart v0.9.2. logs: 
```
WARN POST /v1/onboard 429 {"retry_after":0.4}
DEBUG token refresh begin
INFO retrying POST /v1/onboard id=null
INFO POST /v1/onboard 201 id=onb_9d2
```
jon: that's unsafe replay territory. client retried and backend created a second resource. quickstart doesn't demonstrate idempotency headers for mutating calls.
sahil: two separate fixes: 1) make SDK and sample apps use exp backoff + full jitter (avoid synchronized retries), 2) sampleapps should show setting an Idempotency-Key on mutates or use an SDK helper. note: node/go already ship small helpers; python quickstart is missing parity.
tara: policy question — should SDK auto-add idempotency keys for all mutates? that risks changing behavior for apps that intentionally create multiple distinct resources. maybe auto-add only when call marked "safe_to_dedupe" by API spec.
priya: suggestion: implement a lightweight client middleware in python that can be enabled in quickstart: it will add an Idempotency-Key for annotated calls and handle exp backoff with full jitter. sample config: 
```
# suggested defaults
retry_attempts = 7
retry_base_ms = 120
retry_max_ms = 2500
safe_replay_window_s = 8
```
jon: add the pseudo backoff example to the quickstart: 
```
# full jitter exponential backoff
backoff = min(retry_max_ms, retry_base_ms * (2 ** attempt))
sleep_ms = random.uniform(0, backoff)
time.sleep(sleep_ms / 1000.0)
```
sahil: also recommend server-side improvements: honor Idempotency-Key TTL (e.g., 24h) and return a clear 409 with original resource id if duplicate. that helps clients detect duplicates without guessing.
alex: for the immediate customer fix i'll open a tiny quickstart PR showing two things: 1) add a tiny helper function add_idempotency(headers) and use it on onboarding POSTs, 2) add a one-paragraph onboarding note about token-refresh + 429 races and recommended retry knobs.
priya: can we also add an e2e test in sampleapp CI that simulates a 429 mid-refresh? simple harness: fake auth server delays refresh until after initial request gets 429; assert only one resource created when idempotency header present.
tara: sounds good. for long-term: SDK parity ticket to add a small Client.mutate(..., idempotency_mode="opt-in|auto|none") param so users can opt-in. default should be "opt-in".
jon: important UX detail: sampleapp should show the header plus a comment why you might NOT want to enable it for all calls. tiny docs blurb + link to retry playbook.
ci-bot: created INT-2419 python-sdk-idempotency-parity; draft PR: github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/201
alex: will open quickstart PR after lunch and include the PR link here. tagging this thread for follow-up. :thumbsup:
